address: The Crown Building, 730 5th Ave, New York, New York, 10019-4105, US
description:
Situated at the iconic corner of 57th Street and Fifth Avenue, the Crown Building is a beacon of luxury, notable for its Beaux Arts design, upscale retail boutiques, and the opulent Aman New York hotel and residences. Amid a backdrop of ultra-luxury residential skyscrapers, close to famous destinations like Central Park and Rockefeller Center, and surrounded by high-end retail and dining, the Crown Building stands out as one of the most stunning architectural and cultural achievements in Manhattan.


The Crown Building's ground level houses luxury retailers including Bulgari, Ermenegildo Zegna, and Mikimoto as well as flagship boutiques for Chopard and CHANEL. The latter, a two-story boutique designed by the renowned New York-based architect and long-standing CHANEL collaborator Peter Marino, represents the brand's first standalone store in the U.S. dedicated solely to CHANEL Watches and Fine Jewelry. With these distinguished retail offerings, and with Aman New York occupying its upper floors, the Crown Building exemplifies luxury and location, further cementing its status as an iconic Manhattan landmark.
